snippet.title: Spray Paint Simulator | Release Date Trailer | PC, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, Xbox
snippet.description:
Spray Paint Simulator launches:
🗓️ May 29 – PC (Steam), PlayStation 4/5, Xbox One/Series X|S (Game Pass)
🗓️ June 19 – Nintendo Switch
Transform dull rooms, vehicles—even robots. Then play Free Spray mode and paint your own way, solo or with a friend. Relaxing, creative, and deeply satisfying.

Free demo available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811340/Spray_Paint_Simulator/
